name: Matroska 时码庭：cluster、cue 索引与多轨帧时间证据
narrative_steps: import baseline and verify every raw coordinate is retained
revise TimecodeScale parameter (local, affects time projections)
mutate one direct source and inspect damage containment
two reviewers make conflicting decisions on the same version

mutations.unknown_length: segment size bytes rewritten to all-ones unknown length
mutations.relative_tc_overflow: video SimpleBlock relative timecode set to 0x7FFF raw
mutations.lacing_corrupt: first audio lace size table forced beyond payload
mutations.discard_padding: DiscardPadding rewritten to a large negative value
mutations.cue_mispoint: first CueClusterPosition points into cluster payload
mutations.track_timebase_divergence: source annotation: audio track scale differs (parameter decision)
mutations.cluster_gap: cluster 3 timecode jumps from 2000 to 9000 ticks
